PLAN "12-week post-meniscus strength for skier"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase lower-body and overall strength while protecting repaired medial meniscus; prepare for skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Mobility" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - protected":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat (rear-foot elevated) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Seated leg curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hip abduction machine 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          row 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Bent-over row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Overhead press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower stability & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Trap bar deadlift (moderate ROM) 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Reverse lunge (static, no deep flexion) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Glute bridge (barbell) 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Single-leg Romanian deadlift (bodyweight/dumbbell) 3x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Calf raise seated 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad mobility 5m
    WEEK 2:
